findings.detail: The document requires submission of the bidder's legal form and name, authorized signatory's title and full name, legal and/or physical address, identification code, bank name, bank code, account number, phone number, and email address.
The form includes a field at the bottom for the bidder's signature and stamp ('პრეტენდენტის ხელმოწერა და ბეჭედი').

limitations: The document is an isolated single-page template (Annex N1) and does not represent the full tender documentation.

Information regarding products, quantities, technical specifications, deadlines, delivery terms, eligibility criteria, bank guarantees, payment conditions, warranty, penalties, and disqualification grounds is completely missing from this document.
